featuresPage.title: Advanced Infrastructure
featuresPage.subtitle: Dive deep into the technology that powers Prism Cloud Lite. Built for reliability, scale, and intelligence.

security.title: Enterprise Identity & Security
security.description: Standardized authentication and authorization layers ensuring your visual network remains under your control.
techPoints: OpenID Connect (OIDC) & OAuth 2.0 integration for enterprise-grade identity management.
Single Logout (SLO) support ensures all sessions are terminated across the ecosystem.
Secure cookie-based session management with HttpOnly and SameSite enforcement.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) governing every API endpoint and device command.

transcode.title: Smart Cloud Transcoding
transcode.description: Ensure your content plays flawlessly on any hardware, regardless of original file formats or bitrates.
techPoints: Distributed transcoding workers powered by FFmpeg for high-throughput media processing.
Automatic H.264/AVC optimization to maximize compatibility across heterogeneous device fleets.
Cloud-native storage integration with MD5 content-addressing for instant deduplication.
Priority queueing system ensuring urgent content is processed with millisecond latency.

editor.title: Professional Visual Editor
editor.description: A powerful WYSIWYG studio that bridges the gap between creative design and technical deployment.
techPoints: High-performance Canvas-based layout engine supporting complex multi-layer stacking.
Real-time preview system that mirrors device-side rendering logic for precision.
Dynamic resolution support with automatic aspect-ratio correction and safe-zone guides.
Versioned snapshots allow for instant rollbacks and history tracking of program changes.

analytics.title: Real-time Fleet Analytics
analytics.description: Total visibility into your global infrastructure with sub-second telemetry and health monitoring.
techPoints: Server-Sent Events (SSE) backbone for live, push-based heartbeat and metric updates.
Time-series data aggregation for CPU, Memory, and Storage trends across thousands of nodes.
Automated health-check loops with intelligent threshold-based alerting systems.
Deep-dive telemetry including network signal strength and firmware-level diagnostics.

developer.title: API-First & Extensible
developer.description: Built for developers by developers. Integrate Prism Cloud into your existing enterprise stack seamlessly.
techPoints: Robust RESTful API with comprehensive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for all services.
Programmable Webhooks for real-time integration with external ERP/CRM systems.
Developer API Keys with granular permissions and automated rotation capabilities.
Custom Device Columns and metadata support for complex business-specific tagging.

audit.title: Immutable Audit Trail
audit.description: Comprehensive logging for compliance, security, and troubleshooting across the entire network.
techPoints: Structured operation logs capturing every command, parameter, and execution result.
Change tracking for all media, programs, and schedules with detailed actor attribution.
Exportable audit reports in multiple formats (XLSX, Parquet) for long-term archiving.
Distributed tracing integration for end-to-end visibility of complex batch operations.

aiAssistant.title: Next-Gen AI Co-pilot
aiAssistant.description: More than just a chatbot. An autonomous agent that understands your infrastructure and automates operations.
techPoints: Powered by Spring AI with multi-model support including GPT-4, Gemini, and local vLLM.
Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using pgvector and semantic document indexing.
Autonomous Function Calling allows the AI to query real-time database and monitoring data.
BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) architecture for privacy-conscious enterprise deployments.

roadmap.title: Development Journey
roadmap.subtitle: How we built a professional-grade digital signage cloud in just 30 days. A story of focus, engineering excellence, and AI collaboration.

items.title: Genesis & Architecture
items.description: Established the high-performance base using React + Vite. Built the core Auth system (OIDC/OAuth2) and the foundational dashboard layouts.

items.title: Media & Studio Core
items.description: Launched the Media Library with MD5 deduplication and the Visual Editor. The Canvas-based engine allows for complex, multi-layer program design.

items.title: Fleet Command & Control
items.description: Implemented the resilient device communication protocol. Real-time command dispatching and delta-update publishing became a reality.

items.title: The AI Breakthrough
items.description: Integrated Spring AI and Function Calling. Prism AI became an autonomous agent capable of diagnosing offline devices and searching knowledge bases via RAG.

items.title: Polishing & Ecosystem
items.description: Refined the UX with multi-language support (EN/ZH) and advanced telemetry visualization. Finalizing the Landing experience for launch.
